relations.subject: Philip Yampolsky
relations.evidence: In December 1991, the Publication Committee was organized at the Numata Center, with Professor Philip Yampolsky as the Chairperson. To our sorrow, Professor Yampolsky passed away in July 1996

relations.subject: Kenneth Inada
relations.evidence: thankfully Dr. Kenneth Inada is continuing the work as Chairperson.

relations.subject: Kenneth Inada
relations.evidence: In July 1996, the Committee unfortunately lost its valued Chairperson, Dr. Philip Yampolsky... In February 1997, I was appointed to guide the Committee in his place.

relations.subject: MAYEDA Sengaku
relations.object: Translation Committee of the BDK English Tripitaka
relations.evidence: After these severe blows, the Committee elected me, Vice President of Musashino Women's College, to be the Chair in October 1995... The present members of the Committee are MAYEDA Sengaku
